mapper.select: SELECT user_managed_groups.id, user_managed_groups.user_id as managed_group_user_id, user_managed_groups.group_id as managed_group_group_id, user_managed_groups.update_time as managed_group_update_time, groups.id as group_id, groups.name as group_name, groups.powtoon_group_id as group_powtoon_group_id, groups.parent_code as group_parent_code, groups.master_id as group_master_id, groups.update_time as group_update_time FROM user_managed_groups JOIN groups ON user_managed_groups.group_id = groups.id AND groups.master_id = #{masterId} WHERE managed_group_user_id = #{userId}
